key.name: blur-osd
key.description: Apply blur effect to OSD indicators (volume, brightness, etc.)

key.name: blur-notifications
key.description: Apply blur effect to notification banners

key.name: blur-panel-popups
key.description: Apply blur effect to pop-ups from panel buttons (calendar, quick settings, etc.)

key.name: sigma
key.description: Blur radius used when not reading from Blur my Shell

key.name: brightness
key.description: Blur brightness used when not reading from Blur my Shell

key.name: opacity
key.description: Semi-transparent dark overlay applied on top of the blur (0 = none, 255 = fully opaque). Works independently of Blur my Shell.
